important_caveats: The master catalog is a merged snapshot, not a validated conjunction-assessment catalog.
The 30-day epoch threshold is a preliminary data-freshness filter, not proof of orbit accuracy.
Future-dated epochs were flagged for review and should not be used until verified.
LEO_CONFINED uses catalog apogee altitude <= 2000 km; LEO_CROSSING uses perigee altitude <= 2000 km with apogee above 2000 km.
GP mean elements are intended for SGP4; do not treat them directly as precise osculating elements for Cowell propagation.
Object type classifications are preserved from GP and SATCAT; operational status requires separate interpretation.
